# Yale Landing

> Yale Landing is a small shopping center at 2500 Yale Blvd SE, Albuquerque, NM 87106, at Yale and Gibson, 1.2 miles from the Albuquerque International Sunport and about 400 feet from Kirtland Air Force Base. Tenants: Perico's Burritos · Tacos (family-owned Mexican and New Mexican food since 1982), Paletería Cuauhtémoc (handmade paletas, ice cream and aguas frescas, Suite A) and FMV Brewing Co. (New Mexico taproom, Suite G). Free parking with 480 shared spaces and patio seating.

Two spaces are available for lease:

- Suite B: about 3,550 SF storefront (about 3,000 SF inline plus a 550 SF private patio), $21.00 per SF per year NNN. Suited to fast casual food, clinics (physical therapy, chiropractic), boutique fitness (yoga, pilates, cycling), pet grooming or a small vet clinic, offices (tax, insurance, contractor), martial arts, tutoring and after-school programs.
- Suites E + F: about 12,600 SF of flex space, 20-foot clear, column-free center span, divisible from about 4,000 SF, $15.79 per SF per year NNN. Suited to warehouse and distribution, trade contractors, gyms and event centers.
- Tenant improvement (TI) packages are available. Leasing contact: Ted Bustos, 505-948-9171, ted@yalelandingmarketing.com. Brochure: https://yalelandingabq.com/pdf/

## Places to eat and drink

- [Best Burritos in Albuquerque](https://yalelandingabq.com/best-burritos-albuquerque/): Looking for the best burritos in Albuquerque? Perico's has been family-owned since 1982 — half-pound burritos, green chile, carne adovada and chicharrón, 1.2 miles from the airport.
- [Breakfast Burrito Near the Albuquerque Airport](https://yalelandingabq.com/breakfast-burrito-albuquerque/): Breakfast burritos near the Albuquerque airport from 9am. Egg, potato, beans and cheese with red or green chile at Perico's, 1.2 miles from the Sunport. Add bacon or sausage.
- [Breweries Near the Albuquerque Airport](https://yalelandingabq.com/breweries-near-albuquerque-airport/): The closest taproom to the Albuquerque Sunport. Seven New Mexico beers on tap from Santa Fe Brewing, La Cumbre, Marble and Canteen, plus cocktails and coffee. Veteran-owned.
- [Catering Near the Albuquerque Airport](https://yalelandingabq.com/catering-albuquerque-airport-area/): New Mexican catering near the Albuquerque airport, Kirtland AFB and Sandia Labs. Enchilada casserole, tamales by the dozen, posole by the gallon and fiesta trays from Perico's.
- [Brewery Near the Albuquerque Airport](https://yalelandingabq.com/fmv-brewing/): FMV Brewing Co. — seven New Mexico beers on tap, cocktails on local spirits, and coffee roasted in house at 2500 Yale Blvd SE, Suite G. The closest taproom to the Albuquerque Sunport. Open Wed–Sun.
- [Late Food Near the Albuquerque Airport](https://yalelandingabq.com/late-night-food-albuquerque-airport/): What's open in the evening near the Albuquerque airport. Paletería Cuauhtémoc until 9pm daily, FMV Brewing until 9pm Wed–Sat. 1.2 miles from the Sunport, free parking.
- [Mexican Food Near the Albuquerque Airport](https://yalelandingabq.com/mexican-food-albuquerque-airport-area/): Authentic Mexican and New Mexican food near the Albuquerque airport. Perico's has been family-owned since 1982 — half-pound burritos, red or green chile, stuffed sopapillas.
- [Paletas & Aguas Frescas in Albuquerque](https://yalelandingabq.com/paletas-aguas-frescas-albuquerque/): Handmade Mexican paletas, aguas frescas, mangonadas, elote and shaved ice in Albuquerque. Paletería Cuauhtémoc is open until 9pm daily, 1.2 miles from the airport.
- [Paletas & Ice Cream Near the Albuquerque Airport](https://yalelandingabq.com/paleteria-cuauhtemoc/): Paletería Cuauhtémoc at 2500 Yale Blvd SE, Suite A — handmade Mexican paletas, ice cream, aguas frescas and snacks minutes from the Albuquerque Sunport. Open until 9pm daily.
- [Patio Dining Near the Albuquerque Airport](https://yalelandingabq.com/patio-dining-albuquerque/): Outdoor dining and patio seating near the Albuquerque airport. Every storefront at Yale Landing has a patio, plus a fire pit and mountain views. Free parking, 1.2 miles from the Sunport.
- [Mexican Food Near the Albuquerque Airport](https://yalelandingabq.com/pericos/): Perico's Burritos · Tacos at 2500 Yale Blvd SE — family-owned Mexican and New Mexican food 1.2 miles from the Albuquerque Sunport. Burritos, tacos, stuffed sopapillas, takeout and catering.
